title: Bass players with Goodman
summary: Wilson names Harry Goodman, Sid Weiss, Slam Stewart and Mike Bryan.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: Some of the bass players you played with in Benny Goodman's band, Harry Goodman, his brother was there?
Yes. The whole period I was with Goodman, Harry was the bass player, before I came in and after I left. And later, after I left, Annie Bernstein came in on bass. Great bass player.

Sid Weiss. Oh, yes, I played with Sid Weiss, much later, after I rejoined Benny for the "Seven Lively Arts Show" and then after that did some dates on the road. And Sid Weiss was on bass with Red Norvo and Slam Stewart. Mike Bayer was in the sextet with Benny.
